reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+4.0% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +4.0%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Beta Bionics, Inc. Sued for Securities Law Violations; Investors Should Contact Block & Leviton To Learn How They Might Recover Their Losses
top.summary: Beta Bionics, Inc. faces a securities fraud lawsuit for allegedly misleading investors about the safety of its iLet Bionic Pancreas device. The company downplayed FDA concerns about over 18,000 unreported complaints, characterizing them as 'benign' while the FDA warning letter later contradicted these claims. The stock fell from $31.99 to under $13 per share between July 2025 and February 2026. Eligible investors who purchased shares during this period may recover losses.

top.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Beta Bionics, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BBNX
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Beta Bionics, Inc. (NASDAQ: BBNX) on behalf of investors who purchased common stock between July 30, 2025 and February 24, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Beta Bionics made materially false and misleading statements about its iLet Bionic Pancreas insulin pump, which the FDA found to be malfunctioning and dosing patients with dangerously high insulin levels. The company allegedly failed to disclose thousands of complaints and hundreds of life-threatening events to the FDA. The deadline for investors to serve as lead plaintiff is November 3, 2026.

top.title: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. Notice of September 28, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
top.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against Capricor Therapeutics for failing to disclose material information regarding changes to its statistical analysis plan for its lead drug candidate Deramiocel. The FDA found the company made undisclosed modifications to the analysis plan just before data unblinding, which the agency deemed post-hoc and exploratory. Following FDA briefing documents on July 27, 2026, Capricor's stock plummeted 64% to $7.00 per share. Investors who purchased shares between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 can apply to join the lawsuit by September 28, 2026.

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. CAPR Securities Between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is alerting investors about pending securities fraud class action lawsuits against Capricor Therapeutics, Rackspace Technology, and Bloom Energy. The primary focus is on Capricor, which faces allegations of making false statements regarding changes to its statistical analysis plan for the Deramiocel drug candidate without FDA approval. The FDA subsequently rejected the drug, causing Capricor's stock to plummet 64% on July 27, 2026, and an additional 36% on July 30, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 28, 2026.

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired Bloom Energy Corporation BE Securities Between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP announced pending securities class action lawsuits against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly making false statements about its reliance on Chinese scandium supplies. A short-seller report on July 8, 2026 revealed that Bloom Energy sourced scandium from China through intermediaries despite claiming minimal China supply chain dependence, causing the stock to fall 5.7%. The firm is seeking lead plaintiffs with a September 28, 2026 deadline.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. (CAPR) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Capricor Therapeutics for allegedly making false statements about its Deramiocel cell therapy between December 2025 and July 2026. The FDA's briefing documents criticized the company's statistical analysis methods, and an advisory panel voted 9-3 against the therapy's efficacy, causing the stock to plummet 62% on July 27, 2026. Investors who purchased shares during the class period are urged to file claims by September 28, 2026.

top.title: ISRG's da Vinci Study Shows Better Outcomes Across 13 Common Conditions
top.summary: Intuitive Surgical published a large meta-analysis in Annals of Surgery Open showing da Vinci robotic-assisted surgery delivered significant perioperative improvements across 13 benign procedures compared to laparoscopic and open surgery. Results included 54% lower conversion to open surgery, 69% reduction in blood transfusions versus open surgery, and 46% fewer 30-day complications. The da Vinci 5 platform continues gaining momentum with over 1,700 systems installed. ISRG stock gained ~8% following the announcement and currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

top.title: GSK Inks $750M Deal to Add Experimental Blood Cancer Therapy
top.summary: GSK has agreed to acquire global rights to Chimagen Biosciences' investigational trispecific T-cell engager (TCE) for up to $750 million. The candidate targets two tumor-associated antigens simultaneously and is designed to improve efficacy and tolerability in multiple myeloma treatment, with Phase I studies expected to begin in 2027. This acquisition expands GSK's multiple myeloma portfolio and strengthens its focus on multi-specific T-cell therapies.

top.title: Lupus Nephritis Market on a Growth Trajectory at a CAGR of 7% During the Forecast Period (2026–2036), as Innovative Therapies Gain Momentum | DelveInsight
top.summary: The lupus nephritis market is projected to grow at a 7% CAGR through 2036, driven by increasing disease awareness, improved diagnosis, and expanding adoption of targeted therapies. The market was valued at USD 2.1 billion in 2025 across seven major markets. Three therapies have received FDA approval (belimumab, voclosporin, and obinutuzumab), while a robust pipeline of innovative treatments including CAR-T therapies, complement inhibitors, and monoclonal antibodies is expected to transform disease management.

top.title: GSK Presents Jideytro Data for Potential Use in First-Line NSCLC
top.summary: GSK announced positive data from the ARROS-1 study showing Jideytro (zidesamtinib) achieved a 94% response rate in first-line ROS1-positive NSCLC patients, with 90% remaining progression-free at 12 months and 70% of patients with brain metastases achieving complete tumor clearance. The drug was acquired through GSK's purchase of Nuvalent and is expected to support a supplemental FDA application for first-line use expansion.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +5.4 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +5.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Netflix holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 22.35, trading at a premium to its industry average.

top.title: GTN vs. NFLX: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
top.summary: Gray Media (GTN) and Netflix (NFLX) are compared as potential value stock investments in the Broadcast Radio and Television sector. Gray Media emerges as the superior value option with a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, forward P/E of 2.08, and Value grade of A, compared to Netflix's Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), forward P/E of 21.54, and Value grade of D. GTN's improving earnings outlook and significantly lower valuation metrics make it the more attractive choice for value investors.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

top.title: Is Cancer the Turnaround Moderna Has Been Looking for Post-COVID?
top.summary: Moderna reported positive Phase III results for its personalized mRNA cancer therapy (intismeran autogene) developed with Merck, showing significant improvements in recurrence-free and distant metastasis-free survival in melanoma patients. The breakthrough validates Moderna's mRNA platform beyond vaccines and opens opportunities across multiple tumor types, while the company simultaneously expands its respiratory vaccine portfolio with RSV, flu, and combination vaccines to reduce COVID-19 dependence.

top.title: Immunotherapy Drugs Market 2026: Precision Medicine, Next-Generation Biologics and Expanding Cancer Indications Fuel Growth Opportunities
top.summary: The global immunotherapy drugs market is experiencing significant growth driven by advances in biotechnology, rising demand for targeted treatments, and expanding therapeutic applications across cancer, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. Key growth factors include increasing disease burden, robust drug pipelines, personalized medicine adoption, and combination therapy development. The Americas and Europe remain dominant markets, while Asia-Pacific is emerging as a high-growth region. Major pharmaceutical and biotech companies are increasing R&D investments and collaboration to accelerate innovation.

California's federal courts, particularly the Central District, accounted for over one-third of national product liability filings, with Los Angeles Superior Court seeing dramatic increases in auto warranty cases under the Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act.

top.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Replimune Group, Inc. following the FDA's rejection of the company's Biologics License Application for RP1 in combination with nivolumab on April 10, 2026. The FDA cited deficiencies in clinical studies and stated the evidence did not meet approval standards. The stock price fell 19.46% on the announcement and an additional 64.29% days later, totaling an 83.75% decline from $4.76 to $1.70 per share. Investors who purchased securities during the class period have until October 5, 2026, to request Lead Plaintiff status.

Investors have until October 5, 2026 to join the class action.

top.title: REPL Shareholder Alert: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Replimune Group, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Levi & Korsinsky
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Replimune Group, Inc. for allegedly failing to disclose regulatory concerns about its RP1 trial design to shareholders. The lawsuit claims the company built its regulatory strategy around single-arm trial designs that the FDA had already questioned, including response criteria inconsistent with RECIST v1.1 standards. Investors who purchased REPL shares between October 20, 2025 and April 10, 2026 experienced significant losses, with the stock declining 84.16% during the class period.

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. CAPR Securities Between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is alerting investors about pending securities fraud class action lawsuits against Capricor Therapeutics, Rackspace Technology, and Bloom Energy. The primary focus is on Capricor, which faces allegations of making false statements regarding changes to its statistical analysis plan for the Deramiocel drug candidate without FDA approval. The FDA subsequently rejected the drug, causing Capricor's stock to plummet 64% on July 27, 2026, and an additional 36% on July 30, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 28, 2026.

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired Bloom Energy Corporation BE Securities Between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP announced pending securities class action lawsuits against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly making false statements about its reliance on Chinese scandium supplies. A short-seller report on July 8, 2026 revealed that Bloom Energy sourced scandium from China through intermediaries despite claiming minimal China supply chain dependence, causing the stock to fall 5.7%. The firm is seeking lead plaintiffs with a September 28, 2026 deadline.

top.title: Kirby McInerney LLP Alerts Investors Who Acquired Rackspace Technology, Inc. RXT Securities Between May 7, 2026 and July 8, 2026 of Pending Lawsuit
top.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP announced pending securities class action lawsuits against Rackspace Technology for allegedly making false statements about its business transition to enterprise AI. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased RXT securities between May 7, 2026 and July 8, 2026. Rackspace's stock fell 33.6% on July 9, 2026 after the company revealed significant revenue guidance cuts of $150 million and disclosed that AI investments would require major resource reallocation away from profitable segments.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: ISRG's da Vinci Study Shows Better Outcomes Across 13 Common Conditions
top.summary: Intuitive Surgical published a large meta-analysis in Annals of Surgery Open showing da Vinci robotic-assisted surgery delivered significant perioperative improvements across 13 benign procedures compared to laparoscopic and open surgery. Results included 54% lower conversion to open surgery, 69% reduction in blood transfusions versus open surgery, and 46% fewer 30-day complications. The da Vinci 5 platform continues gaining momentum with over 1,700 systems installed. ISRG stock gained ~8% following the announcement and currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

top.title: Is This the Right Time to Retain Resmed Stock in Your Portfolio?

The company's Masks segment showed strong 13% revenue growth in fiscal 2026, driven by product innovation and improved compliance rates. However, macroeconomic pressures and intense competition pose operational risks.

top.title: Here's Why You Should Add BrightSpring Stock to Your Portfolio Now

top.title: BLCO Gains European CE Mark for Next-Gen SeeLyra Femtosecond Laser
top.summary: Bausch + Lomb (BLCO) announced that its SeeLyra femtosecond laser received European CE Mark approval, expanding its surgical technology portfolio. The platform uses live swept-source OCT for real-time visualization and precise surgical control in cataract, LASIK, and corneal procedures. A limited European launch is planned with broader availability expected in 2027. The global ophthalmic femtosecond lasers market is projected to grow at 7.5% CAGR through 2033.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
